$comment: BigWorld third-party dependencies provided by vcpkg (see docs/vcpkg-migration.md). builtin-baseline pins the exact vcpkg registry commit so dependency builds are reproducible; update it together with VCPKG_ROOT when bumping ports. No vcpkg-configuration.json is needed: only the builtin registry is used (no extra registries, no overlays at the manifest level; the custom triplet is passed per-build via --overlay-triplets). bzip2 is here only because CPython's _bz2 extension is in third_party_python.mak's pythonSharedMods list and this host has no system bzip2 development files. The embedded CPython tree under third_party/python is a heavily patched BigWorld build (BWHooks memory tracking, see bw_changes.txt) and is deliberately NOT taken from vcpkg; the legacy MongoDB C++ driver under third_party/mongodb predates the vcpkg mongo-cxx-driver 3.x API and stays vendored.
name: bigworld
